site.title: {project} - Maya'on Tzelaj Tijonik Re Maxinik
site.description: {project} jun peer-to-peer software re tzelaj tijonik maxinik, banatal pa k'ak'a' decentralized tijonik.
site.ogDescription: Peer-to-peer tzelaj tijonik banatal pa k'ak'a' decentralized tijonik. Maj jun centralized server. Maj jun b'inel xa kqaj.

hero.subtitle: Petenaq peer-to-peer tzelaj tijonik maxinik
hero.description: Banatal pa k'ak'a' decentralized tijonik. Maj jun centralized server. Maj jun b'inel xa kqaj.

about.title: Cho rij
about.intro: {project} jun petenaq plataforma re peer-to-peer tzelaj tijonik maxinik, banatal pa k'ak'a' decentralized tijonik. Kuk'amowi'i jun mebal manaqaj rik'in jun decentralized architectura, kub'ano' chi ri tzelaj tijonik utz xuquje' kuya' chuwach maj k'amol-b'eyal centralizada k'a oj. Re' chak open source, kelesax pa {license}.

decentralized.title: Tz'aqat decentralized red
decentralized.description: Maj jun central server, maj jun b'inel xa kqaj. Ri ajk'amol-b'eyal kkikanoj xuquje' kkiqasaj ri xuwa rik'in xib'iil junam, maj kkikanoj jun central index, tracker o database.

accessControl.title: Q'asal cha'oj manaqaj
accessControl.description: Apachal' utz nub'an ri rixin' red rik'in ri ruq'oxomaxik na'oj kichin'. Pa rij ri ronojel red, kkiq'asax ri ruq'inel ajk'amol-b'eyal: ajaw, ajq'inel, ajwachil', moderador xuquje' tzeqe'l. K'a rik'in q'asal manaqaj cha'oj chrij apachal' nik'asex, k'aslem xuquje' niq'asax ri xuwa.

ui.title: Utz' rub'eyal mebal
ui.description: Ch'ajch'oj xuquje' aninaq media center mebal, b'anatal chinch'i' lemow, televisión xuquje' k'amol-b'eyal. Mëbal ch'utin rik'in teclado, raton, gamepad o telecomando. Ri nim ajk'amol-b'eyal kkitik'aj ri software achi'el headless data server pa command-line mebal.

dataFormat.title: Tijonik nuq'oxomaj winaq
dataFormat.description: Ri LISH tijonik formato banatal pa JSON, kub'ano' manaqaj rub'anik, rusik'ixik xuquje' rusol. Tija' ri xuwa rik'in chajalik xuquje' nuq'oxomaj metadata, achke nub'an apachal' utz nutzu'.

security.title: Eweb'el xuquje' utziril
security.description: Ronojel peer-to-peer tzijoxik q'asal pa cifrado, kub'ano' chi ri xuwa kkic'ojeib'en pa eweb'el chinch'i' rich'ab'ik. Ri ajk'amol-b'eyal kkitik'aj VPN richin nïm anonimato. {project} kuq'i'ij ri eweb'el rik'in ri rub'anik.

crossPlatform.title: Multiplataforma
crossPlatform.description: Ri software k'o k'a Windows, Linux xuquje' macOS. Tatik'aj k'a apachal' plataforma najowaj.

download.title: Q'asaj
download.description: Tach'apo' {project} chi ri aplataforma. Ronojel q'asal manqaq xuquje' open source.

macos.title: Nimalaj b'eyal chwach ri macOS ajk'amol-b'eyal:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper xa kchak ri aplikaciones machaj juch'utal/notariado xq'asax pa internet rik'in {error} sachoj.
macos.runCommand: Toq xq'asax ri DMG o ZIP, manaq xajaqi ri aplicación, tab'ana' re' rub'eyal pa terminal:
macos.exampleDmg: Achi'el ruwach, toq xachajinik pa DMG:
macos.explanation: Re' kelesax ri rub'anik chuwach cuarentena xuquje' nuya' chwach ri aplicación richin nutik'aj.
